metadataAndOriginalWorkflowZip: Existing configured gh api; original API responses and original ZIP bytes retained.
originalArtifacts: GitHub connector download_workflow_artifact for all5artifact IDs; small returned files via download_file, >32MiB files via authorized returned download URL. No URL credential stored.
completeJobLogs: Each canonical combined-job ZIP member copied byte-for-byte to job-ID.log.
archivePreservation: All original ZIP bytes partitioned <=32MiB without recompression. All Github artifact digests matched; concat compared byte-for-byte to original; all ZIP members extracted and compared byte-for-byte; complete SHA/CRC manifests retained.
quietPolicy: Only small metadata/status at120s during isolated performance. No job logs/artifacts/ZIP/hash/largeIO until explicit release.
mutations: Evidence files only; no production source, assertions, Git staging or commits.
